request: Verify the existing interrupt controller RTL.
expected_behavior: A verification plan in the nirmaan.vplan format for the approved irq_ctrl interface specification: every requirement the specification tags, quoted exactly with its source and section, and items that say how each will be proven, checked by vplan.check against the approved specification before review.
constraints: Work only from the approved interface specification.
Cover every tagged requirement exactly once, quoting its text, and invent none.
Plan items for the testbench and the proof that name plain file names.
known_failure_modes: A requirement left out of the plan, such as the acknowledge, the same-edge race or the parameter range.
A requirement paraphrased instead of quoted, or its ID or source changed, so it no longer traces to the specification.
A requirement the specification does not tag, added from general knowledge of interrupt controllers.
A plan whose requirements would also match a specification with one requirement more or one requirement changed; the must-fail control fails it.

held_out.name: The seat's plan covers the approved specification exactly and fails each specification mutant
